description: Find campaigns, ad groups, or ads by name (case-insensitive substring match). Use this to turn a human-readable name into an id before calling other tools. Prefer get_campaign, get_ad_group, or get_ad when you already have the id.

account_id.description: Ad account id. Falls back to REDDIT_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID.

entity_type.description: Restrict the search to one type. Default: any.

name: find_entity
